_readme: This is the file you edit whenever you ship a Google Play update. Add one object to the top of the 'releases' array (newest release first) with the version number, the date you released it, and a short list of player-facing changes. Delete this '_readme' key and the example entry below once you've added your real releases. No other file needs to change — the changelog page reads this one directly.

releases.version: EXAMPLE — replace with your real version
highlights: Replace this entry with your actual release notes
One short line per change, written for players (not commit messages)
Add a new entry like this one to the top of the list for every future release
